author: HorizonTuner · Bagley as Codex
description: R34 / V-spec tachometer layout adapted to the supplied Nür reference, with a Nür 300 analog speed face and matching LCDs. Only the analog speed face and needle are fixed to literal kmh; digital speed follows selected kmh/mph units. Tach LCD shows available lap timing, otherwise current power and torque in selected units (HP by default). Left tire-temperature and right boost gauges use mirrored off-center pivots. Five NISMO MFD Ver.II-inspired pages; original core artwork and honest N/A for unavailable telemetry. Change pages in HUD Advanced Settings.
